impact.text: This is a functional bug that leads to inconsistent behavior and breaks a core design intention of the protocol.

precondition_sources.text: The order being amended is expired.
The amendment provides a new, future cancelTimestamp.
The amendment changes only the order's amountInBase (price and side unchanged).

intent_sources.text: The cancelTimestamp should be updated in all amendment scenarios, including when only amountInBase is amended, so an amendment with a new future cancelTimestamp revives the expired order.
